about_the_game:
“HIVECRAFT” is a fun turn-based strategy where you will get to manage a beehive. Breed bees, send them to collect nectar or straight into battle! 

About the game

HIVECRAFT is a fun turn-based strategy game where you can engage in beekeeping. In this game you will be able to breed bees, collect nectar and produce honey from it.

However, on the game map your bees will encounter natural enemies that will try to hinder your progress. For example, a bee-eating bird will hunt your bees, reducing their population, and a roaming bear may try to devour the whole hive!

Game Modes:

The game features three exciting modes:

  • Single-player - in this mode you will become the master of the bee family, opening new horizons for colony development. You will have to build hives, form swarms and defend against dangerous natural threats.

  • Player Vs Bots - In addition to the standard tasks of collecting nectar, producing honey, and defending against natural enemies, you'll face challenges from artificial intelligence. The hostile wasps, controlled by AI will threaten your hives, seeking to expand their influence on the game location.

  • PvP - this mode combines all the features of the previous modes, but with one important difference: you compete against another player with his own bee colony, instead of AI.

You are waiting for

  • There are more than 50 different levels in the game. Each filled with fun game strategic puzzles and challenging tasks.

  • You can create your own maps and share them with other players, as well as download other people's maps from Steam Workshop.

  • The game has three modes: for those who like to play alone, play against AI and for those who prefer to compete with other players on the network.

  • The graphic design of the game is pleasing to the eye, and the music contributes to the atmosphere of peace and tranquility.
